name: balloon_fpr_tests
description: Functional tests for balloon free page reporting (VIRTIO_BALLOON_F_PAGE_REPORTING). The balloon device template offers the FPR feature bit and the feature is opt-in on the driver side (EnableFpr). All thresholds are derived from the guest RAM size observed at runtime (floor = max(RAM/16, 128 MB), hysteresis band = clamp(RAM/32, 256 MB, 1 GB)), so the suite runs unchanged across guest sizes at the driver's default derivation (the pressure case still needs RAM enough for its allocation). Explicit registry overrides (MinFreeMb/MinCommitMb/HysteresisMb) are not accounted for. These are behavioral assertions on guest-visible memory counters; feature negotiation and held-page ownership are outside this suite's scope.
